customer.intro: FixBridge is a pilot (trial) service in Jabalpur, run by a small team. It is not yet a registered company. Please read and accept our terms.
customer.b1: FixBridge connects you with independent technicians. The technician does the work and is responsible for it.
customer.b2: The price is agreed in the app before work starts. Any extra charge needs a reason and your approval.
customer.b3: During the pilot you pay the technician directly, in cash, after the job. FixBridge does not collect any money.
customer.b4: Report any damage or problem within 24 hours, with photos, from the booking or on WhatsApp.
customer.b5: Booking records (codes, quotes, times) may be used to settle disputes. False complaints or abuse can close your account.
customer.checkbox: I have read and agree to the Terms & Conditions and the Privacy Policy, and I am 18 or older.
customer.outdated: The terms were just updated — please review them again.

partner.intro: FixBridge is a pilot (trial) service in Jabalpur, run by a small team. It is not yet a registered company. Please read and accept the partner agreement.
partner.b1: You work as an independent technician, not as a FixBridge employee. You use your own tools and safety gear.
partner.b2: You are responsible for the quality of your work and for any damage you cause.
partner.b3: 0% commission during the pilot. The customer pays you directly; never ask for more than the price approved in the app.
partner.b4: Always use the start and end codes, and send every price change through the app.
partner.b5: Booking records may be used to settle disputes. Misconduct, fraud or unsafe work means suspension.
